verdicts.reason: A: the building image is shrunk to a thin sliver on the left edge, the headline is small for a story canvas and leaves 'us.' orphaned on its own line, and about 55% of the canvas (top and bottom) is dead white space, so it reads as a shrunk banner. B: the headline is set big enough to dominate as it should and doesn't collide with the image, but it breaks into five ragged lines with single words ('not', 'the') on their own, and the image is still a tiny strip pinned to the left edge with large empty bands above and below. Still, B has better hierarchy and fits the vertical format better.
